title: Shapley subset distribution on a fixed set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $J$ be a subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Transfer the Shapley subset distribution on a set of size $|J|$ to the subsets of $J$ using the canonical relabeling between $J$ and $\{0,\ldots,|J|-1\}$. The resulting probability mass function is a distribution on the finite subsets of $J$.
caveat: The underlying Shapley subset distribution is not defined in the supplied material.
